name: Saints Simon and Jude
history: Two of the Twelve, kept together because tradition holds that they preached in Persia and were martyred there together. Simon is called the Zealot; Jude, also named Thaddeus, wrote the short letter that bears his name and is the patron of hopeless causes.
meditation: Bring to Saint Jude the situation you have given up on.
prayer: O God, Who have given us a way of coming to know Your name through Your blessed Apostles Simon and Jude, grant us to honor their everlasting glory by becoming more holy and to become more holy by honoring it. Through our Lord Jesus Christ. Amen.
prayerSource: Collect of the day, Roman Missal of 1962
